adjudication.rationale: Verified in diff: `Discourse.Group#findMembers` builds the request URL from `this.get('name')` (`/groups/` + name + `/members.json`). In the admin group editor (`admin/templates/group.hbs`), for existing non-automatic groups (`{{#if id}}`), the `name` field is editable (`{{text-field ... value=name}}`) while the members UI (pagination `next`/`previous`) remains active and calls `group.findMembers()` after updating `offset` (`admin/controllers/admin-group.js.es6`). If the admin edits `name` but hasn’t saved yet, paging will request members for the unsaved name and can fail because the server-side group still exists under the old name.
